codeReview.summary: Core budget/dashboard flows and isolation are implemented, but request parameter validation gaps allow invalid month inputs to trigger 500 responses and year values to overflow into SMALLINT-backed storage.

issues.description: `YearMonth.of(year, month)` is called without validating query params first. For invalid `month` (e.g., 0 or 13), this throws `DateTimeException`, which falls through to the global `Exception` handler and returns HTTP 500 instead of a clear 400 validation error.

`request.year().shortValue()` (and corresponding casts in lookup) can silently overflow because API accepts `Integer year` without range constraints while DB column is `SMALLINT`. Inputs above `Short.MAX_VALUE` are wrapped to incorrect years, causing data corruption/incorrect API echoes.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `backend-worker` skill mandates tests-first TDD (write failing tests before implementation), but transcript shows implementation files were created before tests; `handoff.skillFeedback.followedProcedure` still reports true. Procedure adherence checks appear inconsistent with actual execution.
